stated_by: the project manager, 2 Oct 2026: "water barriers you should have locations - it tells you in the description"
method: Each water-barrier reference's schedule description names the place. Twelve of fifteen have that place marked on the master D001 (a sector label, a turn marker or a park/street label) and use that mark. The three the master does not mark were looked up from their description with TomTom search (2 Oct 2026). Nothing else is inferred.
